gaps.description: Missing state file defaults to ACTIVE (fail-OPEN in break-glass). _load_runtime_state() at stoic-cli:196-199 returns _default_runtime_state() with trading_mode='ACTIVE' when file absent. If state file deleted after Kill (container restart, filesystem cleanup), system silently reverts to ACTIVE with no warning. This is fail-OPEN for the last-resort safety mechanism.
gaps.proposed_fix: Change _load_runtime_state() to distinguish 'never initialized' from 'deleted after Kill'. When a state file is expected but missing, default to KILL or emit a warning + latch. Add sentinel or version tracking to detect post-Kill deletion.
gaps.premortem_section: S5 wrong-impl row: 'missing state -> ACTIVE instead of KILL'
gaps.verdict_impact: S0-003 stays GO (conditional) but this gap blocks RECONCILED until fixed

gaps.description: Scope blocklist at stoic-cli:979 only checks 'transfer'; 'all' and 'withdraw' bypass blocklist entirely. R3A Alpha confirmed probe_results withdrawal check (stoic-cli:987-991) does NOT fire for non-'trade' scopes — the 'else' branch at line 994-998 skips withdrawal validation. A key with scopes: ['all'], withdraw_enabled: false passes ALL checks. Severity upgraded from LOW-MED to MED by R3A cross-review.
gaps.proposed_fix: Switch scopes enforcement to allowlist (only known-safe scopes accepted) OR add 'all', 'withdraw', 'margin' to forbidden scopes list. Add dedicated single-violation test for scopes: ['all'] golden vector.
gaps.verdict_impact: S0-002 stays GO (conditional) — secondary defense (withdraw_enabled boolean) remains

gaps.description: No test for state file deletion mid-session. After emergency kill writes state file, if the file is deleted, the system reverts to ACTIVE. No test exercises this regression path: (a) trigger emergency kill, (b) delete runtime state file, (c) call status/dispatch-check, (d) assert system does NOT report ACTIVE. R3A Beta new finding.
gaps.proposed_fix: Add test_break_glass_mid_session_state_deletion_runtime: kill -> verify KILL -> rm state file -> dispatch-check -> assert KILL or error (not ACTIVE)
gaps.verdict_impact: Required for RECONCILED — proves fail-closed for the P0 code fix

gaps.description: No test asserts contract_version == '5.2' in status/health output. DEFAULT_CONTRACT_VERSION = '5.2' exists at stoic-cli:35 but test_status_command_behavior_runtime does not assert this value appears in the output payload. Premortem S5 wrong-impl (wrong contract_version string) is unblocked.
gaps.proposed_fix: Add assertion: assert_eq!(payload['contract_version'], '5.2') to test_status_command_behavior_runtime
gaps.verdict_impact: AT-022 stays CLAIMED_NOT_PROVEN (HTTP transport missing) but strengthens scaffolding proof

gaps.description: No test asserts build_id value in output. test_status_command_behavior_runtime injects STOIC_BUILD_ID env var but never asserts the injected value appears in the output payload. Premortem S5 wrong-impl (build_id empty/placeholder) is unblocked.
gaps.proposed_fix: Add assertion: assert_eq!(payload['build_id'], injected_value) to test_status_command_behavior_runtime

gaps.description: No test for health subcommand. _cmd_health (stoic-cli:343-366) and _cmd_status (stoic-cli:418-461) are separate functions with different payloads and error handling paths. Only _cmd_status is tested. AT-022 targets /health, not /status. The health function is completely untested in the integration suite. R3A Beta independently confirmed this divergence.
gaps.proposed_fix: Add test_health_command_behavior_runtime exercising './stoic-cli health --format json' with healthy and unhealthy paths
gaps.verdict_impact: Required for any future upgrade of AT-022 verdict

gaps.description: No test checks is_trading_allowed=false when trading_mode=REDUCE_ONLY. _is_trading_allowed_mode returns mode == 'ACTIVE' (stoic-cli:323-324), so REDUCE_ONLY should yield false. Only ACTIVE (true) and KILL-via-missing-policy (false) paths are tested.
gaps.proposed_fix: Add REDUCE_ONLY test case or table-driven mode test: [{ACTIVE, true}, {REDUCE_ONLY, false}, {KILL, false}]
gaps.verdict_impact: Strengthens scaffolding proof for mode handling

gaps.description: [FILL] placeholders remain in launch_policy.md metadata (owner, prepared_by at lines 11-12). Inconsistent with Owner Sign-Off block at line 196 which has owner_signature: admin. R3A Alpha noted this inconsistency.
gaps.proposed_fix: Replace [FILL] with actual values matching the sign-off block

gaps.description: Missing postmortem for S0-001. R1 noted artifacts/story/S0-001/postmortem.md is MISSING but did not include it in remediation table. R3A Alpha flagged this as a missed gap. Per workflow contract, postmortem is required at step 7.1 (may be waived for Phase 0 doc-only stories but should be explicit).
gaps.proposed_fix: Create postmortem or explicitly document Phase 0 doc-only waiver

gaps.description: Tests trigger multiple violations simultaneously instead of isolating single gates. test_api_keys_are_least_privilege_runtime fires 2 violations (withdraw_enabled + withdrawal result), test_api_keys_transfer_privilege_rejected_runtime fires 3 (transfer_enabled + scopes + transfer result). Both assert only one. If a gate regresses, the test may still pass via another gate.
gaps.proposed_fix: Split each into single-violation sub-tests with targeted fixtures

gaps.description: Drill version binding not implemented. drill.md lacks commit hash, build_id, runbook version, and runbook_modified_since_drill flag. Cannot verify drill was run against current system version.
gaps.proposed_fix: Add runbook_commit, system_commit, runbook_modified_since_drill fields to drill.md template

gaps.description: Runbook snapshot has drifted — Dashboard Emergency Action section was added but snapshot not updated. Demonstrates real risk of docs diverging from evidence without CI detection.
gaps.proposed_fix: Re-snapshot runbook or add CI diff check for snapshot freshness

gaps.description: PRD scope.touch lists crates/soldier_infra/src/lib.rs which contains no S0-004 code. Actual enforcement is in stoic-cli (Python). Scope file mismatch.
gaps.proposed_fix: Update scope.touch to reference stoic-cli; document Python-vs-Rust divergence

gaps.description: AT-023 transport/probe behavior is validated only in CLI mode; endpoint/transport assertions remain unproven in slice scope.
gaps.proposed_fix: Transport-level proof for AT-023 is deferred to S8-9 with explicit owner and acceptance criteria in DEBT-S0-004-007.

gaps.description: Probe key/mode validation accepts malformed probe payload shape and continues with partial assumptions, so privilege/bypass outcomes can be under-constrained.
gaps.proposed_fix: Reject malformed probe metadata fields (env, exchange, key_id, timestamp_utc, operator) before mode-specific dispatch-path checks.

gaps.description: No explicit validate_policy({}) test for empty JSON object. Mechanism is proven by individual missing-key tests (~30 in test_policy_loader.py) but no golden vector tests the boundary of a completely empty policy object.
gaps.proposed_fix: Add test: validate_policy({}) -> assert 8 missing-key errors

gaps.description: S0-005 PRD metadata includes enforcing/status AT mappings that exceed slice-0 runtime enforcement coverage.
gaps.proposed_fix: Scope enforcing/status AT lists to in-scope S0 slice behavior or explicitly defer out-of-scope ATs in debt metadata.

gaps.description: Probe provenance unverifiable by machine. key_scope_probe.json has no API call logs, signed timestamps, or CI-based execution evidence. Accepted premortem debt (Assumption 2: probe provenance accepted as CONFIRMED BLIND).
gaps.proposed_fix: Future: require API call logs, signed timestamps, or CI-based probe execution

gaps.description: Risk reduction verification uses drill-only simulate-close --dry-run, not the real close path. Phase 0 limitation — real close procedure requires funded positions.
gaps.proposed_fix: Document actual close procedure; test in Phase 1+ with funded paper positions

gaps.description: TOCTOU race in _load_runtime_state() between path.exists() (line 198) and path.read_text() (line 201). File could be deleted or replaced between check and read. Currently fail-closed on exception path (falls to KILL). Mitigated by single-process architecture. R3A Beta finding.
gaps.proposed_fix: Defer until multi-process. Current exception handler falls to KILL (fail-closed), acceptable for single-process.

gaps.description: AT-022 requires HTTP GET /api/v1/health returning HTTP 200. Implementation is CLI only (./stoic-cli health). No HTTP endpoint exists. PRD explicitly defers HTTP to S8-008. CLAIMED_NOT_PROVEN is correct interim verdict.
gaps.proposed_fix: Implement HTTP endpoint wiring in S8-008; integration test must issue actual HTTP request

gaps.description: Value-range validation deferred — no upper bounds on risk limits in policy loader. Basic range checks present (non-positive rejected) but extreme values (e.g., max_position=999999999) are not bounded.
gaps.proposed_fix: PolicyGuard (S2.2) must handle upper-bound validation at runtime

systemic_gaps.description: No automated diff/CI check for doc-only story snapshots. S0-000 and S0-001 rely on manual `diff` between canonical docs and evidence snapshots. Neither has a CI gate to prevent drift. Both premortems flagged this as debt.

No formal AT-XXX anchors in CONTRACT.md for Phase 0 stories. Only S0-004 claims AT-022 (CLAIMED_NOT_PROVEN). The remaining 5 stories have zero formal ATs. Safety argument rests entirely on implementation tests and doc reviews.

r3b_status: NOT_PERFORMED — retroactive audit of already-passed Phase 0 stories; no review_logged.sh infrastructure used
